2027-06-06.title: Tenth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers
With the Lord there is steadfast love, and with him is great power to redeem
So we do not lose heart … our inner nature is being renewed day by day
Whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother
2027-06-06.verse: And looking at those who sat around him, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers! Whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother.”

2027-06-20.title: Twelfth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: Thus far shall you come, and no farther, and here shall your proud waves be stopped
Give thanks to the Lord, his love is everlasting (or: Alleluia)
If anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation
Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
2027-06-20.verse: He woke up and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” Then the wind ceased, and there was a dead calm.

2027-06-27.title: Thirteenth Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: God did not make death, and he does not delight in the death of the living
I will praise you, Lord, for you have rescued me
Though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor
Talitha cum … Little girl, get up!
2027-06-27.verse: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha cum,” which means, “Little girl, get up!” And immediately the girl got up and began to walk about

2027-06-29.title: Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles
readings: Now I am sure that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me
The angel of the Lord will rescue those who fear him
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith
You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church
2027-06-29.verse: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Simon Peter answered, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”

2027-06-13.title: Eleventh Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: I myself will take a sprig from the lofty top of a cedar … and become a noble cedar
Lord, it is good to give thanks to you
We walk by faith, not by sight
It is like a mustard seed, the smallest of all the seeds on earth
2027-06-13.verse: The kingdom of God is as if someone would scatter seed on the ground, and would sleep and rise night and day, and the seed would sprout and grow, he does not know how.

2027-06-01.title: Saint Justin, Martyr
readings: Where are your acts of charity? Where are your righteous deeds?
Their hearts are firm, secure in the Lord
Give to the emperor the things that are the emperor's, and to God the things that are God's
2027-06-01.verse: Jesus said to them, “Give to the emperor the things that are the emperor's, and to God the things that are God's.” And they were utterly amazed at him.

2027-06-02.title: Wednesday of the Ninth Week in Ordinary Time · Sts Marcellinus and Peter
readings: At that very moment, the prayers of both of them were heard in the glorious presence of God
To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul
He is God not of the dead, but of the living
2027-06-02.verse: He is God not of the dead, but of the living; you are quite wrong.

2027-06-03.title: Saints Charles Lwanga and Companions, Martyrs
readings: Grant that she and I may find mercy and that we may grow old together
Happy is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in his ways
You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart … You shall love your neighbor as yourself
2027-06-03.verse: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.

2027-06-04.title: The Most Sacred Heart of Jesus
readings: My heart recoils within me; my compassion grows warm and tender
With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation
to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge
one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out
2027-06-04.verse: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.

2027-06-05.title: The Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary · St Boniface
readings: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my whole being shall exult in my God
My heart exults in the Lord
His mother treasured all these things in her heart
2027-06-05.verse: Then he went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was obedient to them. His mother treasured all these things in her heart.

2027-06-07.title: Monday of the Tenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: the Father of mercies and the God of all consolation, who consoles us in all our affliction
Taste and see the goodness of the Lord
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
2027-06-07.verse: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all consolation, who consoles us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to console those who are in any affliction with the consolation with which we ourselves are consoled by God.

2027-06-08.title: Tuesday of the Tenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: For in him every one of God's promises is a “Yes.”
Lord, let your face shine on me
You are the salt of the earth … You are the light of the world
2027-06-08.verse: In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.

2027-06-09.title: Wednesday of the Tenth Week in Ordinary Time · St Ephrem, Deacon and Doctor of the Church
readings: not of letter but of spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life
Holy is the Lord our God
I have come not to abolish but to fulfill
2027-06-09.verse: Do not think that I have come to abolish the law or the prophets; I have come not to abolish but to fulfill.

2027-06-10.title: Thursday of the Tenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: all of us, with unveiled faces, seeing the glory of the Lord … are being transformed into the same image
The glory of the Lord will dwell in our land
first be reconciled to your brother or sister, and then come and offer your gift
2027-06-10.verse: For it is the God who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

2027-06-11.title: Saint Barnabas, Apostle
readings: for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith
The Lord has revealed to the nations his saving power
You received without payment; give without payment
2027-06-11.verse: for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were brought to the Lord.

2027-06-12.title: Saturday of the Tenth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: So we are ambassadors for Christ … be reconciled to God
The Lord is kind and merciful
Let your word be ‘Yes, Yes’ or ‘No, No’
2027-06-12.verse: So if anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation: everything old has passed away; see, everything has become new!

2027-06-14.title: Monday of the Eleventh Week in Ordinary Time
readings: See, now is the acceptable time … as having nothing, and yet possessing everything
The Lord has made known his salvation
But I say to you, Do not resist an evildoer
2027-06-14.verse: But I say to you, Do not resist an evildoer. But if anyone strikes you on the right cheek, turn the other also;

2027-06-15.title: Tuesday of the Eleventh Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor
Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
2027-06-15.verse: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may be children of your Father in heaven; for he makes his sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the righteous and on the unrighteous.

2027-06-16.title: Wednesday of the Eleventh Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Blessed the man who fears the Lord
Your Father who sees in secret will reward you
2027-06-16.verse: Each of you must give as you have made up your mind, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

2027-06-17.title: Thursday of the Eleventh Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I promised you in marriage to one husband, to present you as a chaste virgin to Christ
Your works, O Lord, are justice and truth
Pray then in this way: Our Father in heaven
2027-06-17.verse: Pray then in this way: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

2027-06-18.title: Friday of the Eleventh Week in Ordinary Time
readings: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness
From all their afflictions God will deliver the just
Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also
2027-06-18.verse: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

2027-06-19.title: Saturday of the Eleventh Week in Ordinary Time · St Romuald
readings: My grace is sufficient for you, for power is made perfect in weakness
Taste and see the goodness of the Lord
Strive first for the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well
2027-06-19.verse: but he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for power is made perfect in weakness.” So, I will boast all the more gladly of my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may dwell in me.

2027-06-21.title: Saint Aloysius Gonzaga, Religious
readings: Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house to the land that I will show you
Blessed the people the Lord has chosen to be his own
First take the log out of your own eye
2027-06-21.verse: Now the Lord said to Abram, “Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house to the land that I will show you.”

2027-06-22.title: Tuesday of the Twelfth Week in Ordinary Time · St Paulinus of Nola; Sts John Fisher and Thomas More
readings: Let there be no strife between you and me … for we are kindred
He who does justice will live in the presence of the Lord
In everything do to others as you would have them do to you
2027-06-22.verse: Then Abram said to Lot, “Let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herders and my herders; for we are kindred.”

2027-06-23.title: Wednesday of the Twelfth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: He believed the Lord; and the Lord reckoned it to him as righteousness
The Lord remembers his covenant for ever (or: Alleluia)
You will know them by their fruits
2027-06-23.verse: He brought him outside and said, “Look toward heaven and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your descendants be.” And he believed the Lord; and the Lord reckoned it to him as righteousness.

2027-06-24.title: The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist
readings: The Lord called me before I was born; I will give you as a light to the nations
I praise you, for I am wonderfully made
One is coming after me; I am not worthy to untie the thong of the sandals on his feet
2027-06-24.verse: All who heard them pondered them and said, “What then will this child become?” For, indeed, the hand of the Lord was with him.

2027-06-25.title: Friday of the Twelfth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be blameless
See how the Lord blesses those who fear him
Lord, if you choose, you can make me clean
2027-06-25.verse: There was a leper who came to him and knelt before him, saying, “Lord, if you choose, you can make me clean.” He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I do choose. Be made clean!”

2027-06-26.title: Saturday of the Twelfth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Is anything too wonderful for the Lord?
The Lord has remembered his mercy
Lord, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof; but only speak the word
2027-06-26.verse: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have you come under my roof; but only speak the word, and my servant will be healed.”

2027-06-28.title: Saint Irenaeus, Bishop, Martyr and Doctor of the Church
readings: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do what is just?
The Lord is kind and merciful
Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head
2027-06-28.verse: Then Abraham came near and said, “Will you indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

2027-06-30.title: Wednesday of the Thirteenth Week in Ordinary Time · The First Martyrs of the Holy Roman Church
readings: God has heard the voice of the boy where he is
The Lord hears the cry of the poor
When they saw him, they begged him to leave their neighborhood
2027-06-30.verse: And God heard the voice of the boy; and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Do not be afraid; for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

kidsaint: St Thérèse of Lisieux and the little way
